镜头 3（15–21 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：张骞、胡妻；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：十余年，持汉节不失｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：引文「然张骞凿空。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「匈奴留骞十余岁，与妻，有子。然骞持汉节不失。」
镜头 4（21–30 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山、山石剪影；主体：战马｜动作：西走大宛、康居，至大月氏｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：大漠风；音效：驼铃｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他终于逃出，西走数十日至大宛，经康居，到了大月氏。月氏已无报胡之心。」
镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：汉节；飞白题字「凿空」｜动作：归来｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：驼铃｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「归途又被匈奴所得。一年多后——」
镜头 6（36–45 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：出发时百余人，归来时只剩二人。张骞带回西域诸国的见闻，汉通西域自此始。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「出发时百余人，归来时只剩二人。张骞带回西域诸国的见闻，汉通西域自此始。」
镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「然张骞凿空。」，下署《史记·大宛列传》；右下角朱印「凿空」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「然张骞凿空。」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、草原风、大漠风、战后余风；音效：马蹄声、阵风、驼铃；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「凿空」、副题「张骞出使西域」、朱印「凿空」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「然张骞凿空。」——《史记·大宛列传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Opening the West: Zhang Qian's Mission (「凿空」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 139 BCE–126 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Zhang Qian (张骞) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xiong Nu Chanyu (匈奴单于) — ruler, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Hu Qi (胡妻) — commoner, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Tang Yifu (堂邑父) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Han Wudi (汉武帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Da Yueshiwang (大月氏王) — ruler, Yuezhi; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, crenellated city wall | Action: The long road west outside Chang'an | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「凿空」 with vermilion seal 「凿空」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汉武帝闻月氏为匈奴所破，怨匈奴，募能使月氏者。」
Shot 2 (7–15 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Xiong Nu Chanyu, cavalry | Action: Out from Longxi, through Xiongnu land, captured | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「郎官张骞应募，与堂邑父等百余人出陇西，经匈奴，被扣留。」
Shot 3 (15–21 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Zhang Qian, Hu Qi; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Over ten years he never lets go of the Han tally | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「然张骞凿空。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「匈奴留骞十余岁，与妻，有子。然骞持汉节不失。」
Shot 4 (21–30 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; subject: war horse | Action: West to Dayuan, Kangju and the Yuezhi | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: desert wind; SFX: camel bells | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他终于逃出，西走数十日至大宛，经康居，到了大月氏。月氏已无报胡之心。」
Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: 汉节; dry-brush calligraphy 「凿空」 | Action: The return | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: camel bells | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「归途又被匈奴所得。一年多后——」
Shot 6 (36–45 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Over a hundred set out and only two come back; Zhang Qian's reports open Han contact with the Western Regions. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「出发时百余人，归来时只剩二人。张骞带回西域诸国的见闻，汉通西域自此始。」
Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「然张骞凿空。」 signed 《史记·大宛列传》; vermilion seal 「凿空」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「然张骞凿空。」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, steppe wind, desert wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: hoofbeats, wind gust, camel bells; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「凿空」, subtitle 「张骞出使西域」 and vermilion seal 「凿空」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「然张骞凿空。」 — 《史记·大宛列传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.title: 割肉遗细君
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.subtitle: 东方朔
strings.vo.01: 汉武帝即位之初，征召天下贤良之士。平原人东方朔上书自荐，用了三千片木牍，两个人才抬得动。武帝读了两个月才读完。
strings.vo.02: 有一年伏日，武帝下诏赐给侍从官肉。管膳食的大官丞到了傍晚还没来分肉。
strings.vo.03: 东方朔独自拔剑割了一块肉，对同僚说：伏日应当早点回家，我先领受赏赐了。说完揣着肉就走了。
strings.vo.04: 大官丞上奏此事。第二天武帝问他：昨天赐肉，你不等诏令就割肉而去，是怎么回事？让他自己认错。
strings.vo.05: 东方朔再拜，说——
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.fork.prompt: 割肉遗细君——依《汉书》直书，还是听志怪《汉武故事》？
strings.anchor.shangshu_d: 东方朔上书自荐，用三千奏牍
strings.anchor.zize: 东方朔割肉自责，武帝笑而赐之
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.canon.intro: 汉武帝身边最会说笑话的人，其实是一个用三千片木牍上书的人。
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.end.canon: 东方朔说：“受赐不待诏，何无礼也！拔剑割肉，壹何壮也！割之不多，又何廉也！归遗细君，又何仁也！”武帝大笑，说：让你自责，你反倒自夸起来。又赐酒一石、肉百斤，让他带回去给妻子。
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.legend.disclaim: 以下取旧题班固《汉武故事》等书所载：西王母降临汉宫，以仙桃赐武帝，东方朔在窗外偷看，西王母说此儿曾三次偷她的桃子。此类故事出于六朝志怪，史书不载。
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.legend.intro: 汉武故事里说，七月七日夜里，西王母乘紫云车降临汉宫。
strings.scene.xihan.dongfangshuo.end.legend: 志怪故事把东方朔写成了岁星下凡的仙人。民间从此把他画成手捧仙桃的老人，祝寿的图画里常有他。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 汉武帝即位之初，征召天下贤良之士。平原人东方朔上书自荐，用了三千片木牍，两个人才抬得动。武帝读了两个月才读完。
有一年伏日，武帝下诏赐给侍从官肉。管膳食的大官丞到了傍晚还没来分肉。
东方朔独自拔剑割了一块肉，对同僚说：伏日应当早点回家，我先领受赏赐了。说完揣着肉就走了。
大官丞上奏此事。第二天武帝问他：昨天赐肉，你不等诏令就割肉而去，是怎么回事？让他自己认错。
东方朔再拜，说——
东方朔说：“受赐不待诏，何无礼也！拔剑割肉，壹何壮也！割之不多，又何廉也！归遗细君，又何仁也！”武帝大笑，说：让你自责，你反倒自夸起来。
归遗细君，又何仁也！

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】楚汉 · 西汉 · 割肉遗细君（东方朔）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 70 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝建元年间（约前 138 年后）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 东方朔（汉·平原厌次人，太中大夫）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；上书三千牍自荐；伏日拔剑割肉，自责之辞令武帝大笑
- 汉武帝（汉·刘彻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；命其自责，笑而复赐酒肉
- 细君（汉·东方朔之妻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；东方朔割肉归遗之
- 大官丞（汉·掌宫中膳食的小吏）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；日晏不来分肉

镜头 7（64–70 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「归遗细君，又何仁也！」，下署《汉书·东方朔传》；右下角朱印「滑稽」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「归遗细君，又何仁也！」

声音：背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动、脚步声、刀声、衣袂摩挲；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「割肉遗细君」、副题「东方朔」、朱印「滑稽」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「归遗细君，又何仁也！」——《汉书·东方朔传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Meat for His Wife: Dongfang Shuo (「割肉遗细君」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 70 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), c. 138 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Dongfang Shuo (东方朔) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Han Wudi (汉武帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xi Jun (细君) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Da Guancheng (大官丞) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–13 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: crowd | Action: In the petition office two men carry in a huge bundle of writing tablets that fills half the room | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「割肉遗细君」 with vermilion seal 「滑稽」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汉武帝即位之初，征召天下贤良之士。平原人东方朔上书自荐，用了三千片木牍，两个人才抬得动。武帝读了两个月才读完。」
Shot 2 (13–22 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd | Action: On the midsummer feast day meat is to be handed out, but the steward is late and the gentlemen stand waiting | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「有一年伏日，武帝下诏赐给侍从官肉。管膳食的大官丞到了傍晚还没来分肉。」
Shot 3 (22–33 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Dongfang Shuo, sword | Action: One man draws his sword, cuts off a piece of meat, tucks it in his robe and strolls away | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: blade | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「归遗细君，又何仁也！」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「东方朔独自拔剑割了一块肉，对同僚说：伏日应当早点回家，我先领受赏赐了。说完揣着肉就走了。」
Shot 4 (33–44 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Han Wudi, Dongfang Shuo | Action: Next day the emperor, stony-faced, orders him to confess his fault | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「大官丞上奏此事。第二天武帝问他：昨天赐肉，你不等诏令就割肉而去，是怎么回事？让他自己认错。」
Shot 5 (44–50 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Dongfang Shuo, Han Wudi, Xi Jun | Action: He bows twice: taking the gift without waiting — how rude! cutting the meat with a sword — how bold! | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「东方朔再拜，说——」
Shot 6 (50–64 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Dongfang Shuo, Han Wudi, Xi Jun | Action: Canonical outcome: Emperor Wu bursts out laughing — asked to blame himself, he has praised himself — and gives him a dan of wine and a hundred jin of meat to take home to his wife. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「东方朔说：“受赐不待诏，何无礼也！拔剑割肉，壹何壮也！割之不多，又何廉也！归遗细君，又何仁也！”武帝大笑，说：让你自责，你反倒自夸起来。」
Shot 7 (64–70 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「归遗细君，又何仁也！」 signed 《汉书·东方朔传》; vermilion seal 「滑稽」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「归遗细君，又何仁也！」

Sound: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, footsteps, blade, rustling silk; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「割肉遗细君」, subtitle 「东方朔」 and vermilion seal 「滑稽」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「归遗细君，又何仁也！」 — 《汉书·东方朔传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.xihan.mobei.title: 封狼居胥
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.subtitle: 漠北之战
strings.vo.01: 元狩四年，汉发十万骑，大将军卫青、骠骑将军霍去病分道出塞，击匈奴。
strings.vo.02: 卫青出定襄，千余里后遇单于兵阵。
strings.vo.03: 他令武刚车自环为营，纵五千骑往击。会日且入，大风起，沙砾击面。
strings.vo.04: 单于遁走。骠骑将军出代郡二千余里，与左贤王接战。
strings.vo.05: 至狼居胥山——
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.fork.prompt: 封狼居胥——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「酒泉」？
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.canon.intro: 元狩四年春，卫青、霍去病各领五万骑出塞。单于把辎重移到远处，以精兵待于漠北。
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.end.canon: 霍去病封狼居胥山，禅于姑衍，临翰海而还。匈奴远遁，漠南无王庭。
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.legend.disclaimer: 以下是地方传说：酒泉得名，汉人只说“其水若酒”；霍去病倾御酒入泉、与将士共饮，是后世附会的民间故事，不见于汉唐史籍。
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.legend.intro: 传说汉武帝赐霍去病御酒，酒少人多，他把酒倒入泉中，与将士共饮，此地因名酒泉。
strings.scene.xihan.mobei.end.legend: 泉水依旧，故事流传至今。传说汇回正史：汉军远征漠北。

版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。

第 1 行：1. 卫青（大将军）（汉·武将）；2. 霍去病（骠骑将军）（汉·武将）；3. 伊稚斜单于（匈奴单于）（匈奴·君主）。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝元狩四年（前 119 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。
setting.en: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 119 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

characters.name: 卫青
characters.zh: 卫青（汉·大将军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；出定襄，与单于接战，以武刚车自环为营
characters.en: Wei Qing (卫青) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 元狩四年，汉发十万骑，大将军卫青、骠骑将军霍去病分道出塞，击匈奴。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：草、沙｜动作：大漠，地平线无尽｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；干笔擦出沙地｜声音：环境：大漠风｜屏幕文字：片名「封狼居胥」竖排书法与朱印「封狼居胥」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「元狩四年，汉发十万骑，大将军卫青、骠骑将军霍去病分道出塞，击匈奴。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass, sand | Action: The desert, an endless horizon | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; dry-brush scumbled sand | Sound: ambience: desert wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「封狼居胥」 with vermilion seal 「封狼居胥」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「元狩四年，汉发十万骑，大将军卫青、骠骑将军霍去病分道出塞，击匈奴。」

shots.vo: 卫青出定襄，千余里后遇单于兵阵。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（9–15 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：骑兵、旌旗｜动作：两路出塞：定襄与代郡｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卫青出定襄，千余里后遇单于兵阵。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (9–15 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: cavalry, banners | Action: Two armies leave the frontier from Dingxiang and Dai | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卫青出定襄，千余里后遇单于兵阵。」

shots.vo: 他令武刚车自环为营，纵五千骑往击。会日且入，大风起，沙砾击面。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（15–23 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：卫青、盾墙｜动作：武刚车自环为营｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：车轮吱呀｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他令武刚车自环为营，纵五千骑往击。会日且入，大风起，沙砾击面。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (15–23 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wei Qing, shield wall | Action: Wugang wagons ring into a fortified camp | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: creaking wheel | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他令武刚车自环为营，纵五千骑往击。会日且入，大风起，沙砾击面。」

shots.vo: 单于遁走。骠骑将军出代郡二千余里，与左贤王接战。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（23–30 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：烟；主体：骑兵、弓箭｜动作：大风起，沙砾击面｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；淡墨烟气横向飘散；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：暴风雨；音效：阵风、兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「单于遁走。骠骑将军出代郡二千余里，与左贤王接战。」

narration: 元狩四年，汉发十万骑，大将军卫青、骠骑将军霍去病分道出塞，击匈奴。
卫青出定襄，千余里后遇单于兵阵。
他令武刚车自环为营，纵五千骑往击。会日且入，大风起，沙砾击面。
单于遁走。骠骑将军出代郡二千余里，与左贤王接战。
至狼居胥山——
霍去病封狼居胥山，禅于姑衍，临翰海而还。匈奴远遁，漠南无王庭。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Sacrifice at Mount Langjuxu: the Battle of Mobei (「封狼居胥」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 50 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 119 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Wei Qing (卫青) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.xihan.liguang.title: 李广难封
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.subtitle: 射虎没镞
strings.vo.01: 李广镇守右北平时，匈奴人称他为汉之飞将军，几年不敢入侵。有一次他出猎，看见草中的石头，以为是老虎，一箭射去。
strings.vo.02: 走近一看，箭镞整个射进了石头里。他再射，却怎么也射不进去了。
strings.vo.03: 李广一生与匈奴大小七十余战，部下许多人都封了侯，他却始终不得封。他问望气的王朔：难道我的相貌不该封侯吗？王朔问他是否杀过降人。他说曾诱杀羌人降者八百余人，至今后悔。
strings.vo.04: 前 119 年，汉军大举出击漠北，李广屡次请求随行。大将军卫青把他调出东道，与赵食其合军。东道迂远，又没有向导，他们迷了路，没赶上会战。
strings.vo.05: 卫青派长史来问失道的情形，要追究幕府的责任。李广对部下说——
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.quote: 广结发与匈奴大小七十余战，今幸从大将军出接单于兵，而大将军又徙广部行回远，而又迷失道，岂非天哉！
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.fork.prompt: 李广难封——依《史记》直书，还是听诗文「卢纶《塞下曲》」？
strings.anchor.shehu: 李广出猎，见草中石以为虎而射之，中石没镞
strings.anchor.zijing: 李广失道后期，引刀自刭
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.canon.intro: 一箭射进石头的飞将军，打了一辈子仗，到老也没能封侯。他的最后一仗，连敌人都没见到。
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.end.canon: 李广说：“广年六十余矣，终不能复对刀笔之吏。”于是引刀自刭。全军将士皆哭，百姓听说了，无论认识不认识他，老老少少都为他落泪。司马迁说：桃李不言，下自成蹊。
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取唐代卢纶《和张仆射塞下曲》之二对射石的吟咏：诗把射石写在夜里，又写“平明寻白羽，没在石棱中”。诗与史大体相合，增添了画面。
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.legend.intro: 九百年后，卢纶写道：林暗草惊风，将军夜引弓。
strings.scene.xihan.liguang.end.legend: 诗把李广最神奇的一箭写成了千古名句。“飞将军”从此成了边塞诗里最常见的英雄。

黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（水墨特效），题材：李广难封·射虎没镞（前 119 年）。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝元狩四年（前 119 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。
setting.en: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 119 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

characters.name: 李广
characters.zh: 李广（汉·前将军，号“飞将军”）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；老年；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；射石没镞；大小七十余战而不得封侯，漠北失道自刭
characters.en: Li Guang (李广) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; elderly; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 赵食其

characters.en: Zhao Shiqi (赵食其) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 王朔

characters.en: Wang Shuo (王朔) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 李广镇守右北平时，匈奴人称他为汉之飞将军，几年不敢入侵。有一次他出猎，看见草中的石头，以为是老虎，一箭射去。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–13 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：草；主体：李广、弓箭｜动作：右北平的暮色里，草丛中卧着一团黑影，将军拉满弓｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：弓弦｜屏幕文字：片名「李广难封」竖排书法与朱印「飞将军」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李广镇守右北平时，匈奴人称他为汉之飞将军，几年不敢入侵。有一次他出猎，看见草中的石头，以为是老虎，一箭射去。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–13 s, 13 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Li Guang, bow | Action: In the dusk of Youbeiping a dark shape lies in the grass; the general draws his bow to full | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: bowstring | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「李广难封」 with vermilion seal 「飞将军」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李广镇守右北平时，匈奴人称他为汉之飞将军，几年不敢入侵。有一次他出猎，看见草中的石头，以为是老虎，一箭射去。」

shots.vo: 走近一看，箭镞整个射进了石头里。他再射，却怎么也射不进去了。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（13–21 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：山石剪影；中景：草；主体：李广｜动作：第二天，箭杆深深插在一块石头里，箭镞已经看不见｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：低风；音效：石裂｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「走近一看，箭镞整个射进了石头里。他再射，却怎么也射不进去了。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (13–21 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: rock silhouettes; midground: grass; subject: Li Guang | Action: Next morning the shaft is buried deep in a rock, its head no longer visible | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: cracking stone | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「走近一看，箭镞整个射进了石头里。他再射，却怎么也射不进去了。」

shots.vo: 李广一生与匈奴大小七十余战，部下许多人都封了侯，他却始终不得封。他问望气的王朔：难道我的相貌不该封侯吗？王朔问他是否杀过降人。他说曾诱杀羌人降者八百余人，至今后悔。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（21–40 秒，19 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：李广、王朔｜动作：一个老将问望气者：我为何不得封侯｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：引文「广结发与匈奴大小七十余战，今幸从大将军出接单于兵，而大将军又徙广部行回远，而又迷失道，岂非天哉！」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李广一生与匈奴大小七十余战，部下许多人都封了侯，他却始终不得封。他问望气的王朔：难道我的相貌不该封侯吗？王朔问他是否杀过降人。他说曾诱杀羌人降者八百余人，至今后悔。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (21–40 s, 19 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Li Guang, Wang Shuo | Action: An old general asks a diviner: why have I never been made a marquis? | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「广结发与匈奴大小七十余战，今幸从大将军出接单于兵，而大将军又徙广部行回远，而又迷失道，岂非天哉！」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李广一生与匈奴大小七十余战，部下许多人都封了侯，他却始终不得封。他问望气的王朔：难道我的相貌不该封侯吗？王朔问他是否杀过降人。他说曾诱杀羌人降者八百余人，至今后悔。」

shots.vo: 前 119 年，汉军大举出击漠北，李广屡次请求随行。大将军卫青把他调出东道，与赵食其合军。东道迂远，又没有向导，他们迷了路，没赶上会战。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（40–55 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：沙；主体：李广、赵食其、骑兵｜动作：漠北，东道的骑兵在荒漠里转圈，向导早已不见｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：大漠风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 119 年，汉军大举出击漠北，李广屡次请求随行。大将军卫青把他调出东道，与赵食其合军。东道迂远，又没有向导，他们迷了路，没赶上会战。」

shots.vo: 卫青派长史来问失道的情形，要追究幕府的责任。李广对部下说——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（55–63 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：李广、大刀；飞白题字「难封」｜动作：军帐中，他对部下说：广结发与匈奴大小七十余战｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；四角暗角收拢；兵刃金属寒光一闪；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：刀声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卫青派长史来问失道的情形，要追究幕府的责任。李广对部下说——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (55–63 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Li Guang, broadsword; dry-brush calligraphy 「难封」 | Action: In his tent he tells his officers: since I bound up my hair I have fought the Xiongnu more than seventy times | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; vignette closing in from the corners; a cold metallic glint on the blade; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卫青派长史来问失道的情形，要追究幕府的责任。李广对部下说——」

shots.vo: 李广说：“广年六十余矣，终不能复对刀笔之吏。”于是引刀自刭。全军将士皆哭，百姓听说了，无论认识不认识他，老老少少都为他落泪。

shots.vo: 广结发与匈奴大小七十余战，今幸从大将军出接单于兵，而大将军又徙广部行回远，而又迷失道，岂非天哉！

narration: 李广镇守右北平时，匈奴人称他为汉之飞将军，几年不敢入侵。有一次他出猎，看见草中的石头，以为是老虎，一箭射去。
走近一看，箭镞整个射进了石头里。他再射，却怎么也射不进去了。
李广一生与匈奴大小七十余战，部下许多人都封了侯，他却始终不得封。他问望气的王朔：难道我的相貌不该封侯吗？王朔问他是否杀过降人。他说曾诱杀羌人降者八百余人，至今后悔。
前 119 年，汉军大举出击漠北，李广屡次请求随行。大将军卫青把他调出东道，与赵食其合军。东道迂远，又没有向导，他们迷了路，没赶上会战。
卫青派长史来问失道的情形，要追究幕府的责任。李广对部下说——
李广说：“广年六十余矣，终不能复对刀笔之吏。”于是引刀自刭。全军将士皆哭，百姓听说了，无论认识不认识他，老老少少都为他落泪。
广结发与匈奴大小七十余战，今幸从大将军出接单于兵，而大将军又徙广部行回远，而又迷失道，岂非天哉！

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】楚汉 · 西汉 · 李广难封（射虎没镞）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 83 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝元狩四年（前 119 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 李广（汉·前将军，号“飞将军”）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；老年；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；射石没镞；大小七十余战而不得封侯，漠北失道自刭
- 赵食其（汉·右将军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与李广同出东道，亦迷失道路
- 王朔（汉·望气者）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；李广问之：吾不得封侯，何也？
- 卫青（汉·大将军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；徙李广出东道，后令长史问失道状

分镜：
镜头 1（0–13 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：草；主体：李广、弓箭｜动作：右北平的暮色里，草丛中卧着一团黑影，将军拉满弓｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：弓弦｜屏幕文字：片名「李广难封」竖排书法与朱印「飞将军」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李广镇守右北平时，匈奴人称他为汉之飞将军，几年不敢入侵。有一次他出猎，看见草中的石头，以为是老虎，一箭射去。」
镜头 2（13–21 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：山石剪影；中景：草；主体：李广｜动作：第二天，箭杆深深插在一块石头里，箭镞已经看不见｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：低风；音效：石裂｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「走近一看，箭镞整个射进了石头里。他再射，却怎么也射不进去了。」
镜头 3（21–40 秒，19 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：李广、王朔｜动作：一个老将问望气者：我为何不得封侯｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：引文「广结发与匈奴大小七十余战，今幸从大将军出接单于兵，而大将军又徙广部行回远，而又迷失道，岂非天哉！」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李广一生与匈奴大小七十余战，部下许多人都封了侯，他却始终不得封。他问望气的王朔：难道我的相貌不该封侯吗？王朔问他是否杀过降人。他说曾诱杀羌人降者八百余人，至今后悔。」
镜头 4（40–55 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：沙；主体：李广、赵食其、骑兵｜动作：漠北，东道的骑兵在荒漠里转圈，向导早已不见｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；干笔擦出沙地；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：大漠风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 119 年，汉军大举出击漠北，李广屡次请求随行。大将军卫青把他调出东道，与赵食其合军。东道迂远，又没有向导，他们迷了路，没赶上会战。」
镜头 5（55–63 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：李广、大刀；飞白题字「难封」｜动作：军帐中，他对部下说：广结发与匈奴大小七十余战｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；四角暗角收拢；兵刃金属寒光一闪；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：刀声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卫青派长史来问失道的情形，要追究幕府的责任。李广对部下说——」
镜头 6（63–77 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：李广｜动作：正史结局：李广说：“广年六十余矣，终不能复对刀笔之吏。”于是引刀自刭。全军将士皆哭，百姓听说了，无论认识不认识他，老老少少都为他落泪。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李广说：“广年六十余矣，终不能复对刀笔之吏。”于是引刀自刭。全军将士皆哭，百姓听说了，无论认识不认识他，老老少少都为他落泪。」

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Li Guang, Never Ennobled: An Arrow in the Stone (「李广难封」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 83 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 119 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Li Guang (李广) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; elderly; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhao Shiqi (赵食其) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Shuo (王朔) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.xihan.suwu.title: 北海牧羊
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.subtitle: 苏武
strings.vo.01: 天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。
strings.vo.02: 卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。
strings.vo.03: 单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。
strings.vo.04: 匈奴以为神，把他迁到北海无人之处，让他牧公羊，说：公羊生了小羊，就放你回去。
strings.vo.05: 苏武杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落——
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.quote: 武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.fork.prompt: 北海牧羊——依《汉书》直书，还是听演义《前汉演义》？
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.canon.intro: 北海边上，风雪从不停歇。粮食断了，苏武掘野鼠所藏的草实来吃。
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.end.canon: 昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.legend.disclaimer: 鸿雁传书本是《汉书·苏武传》所载汉使的托辞；以下按蔡东藩《前汉演义》第七十五、七十八回改编，对话为小说增饰。
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.legend.intro: 汉使依常惠所教，对单于说：天子在上林中射得一雁，足上系着帛书，说苏武在某泽中。单于大惊。
strings.scene.xihan.suwu.end.legend: 单于视左右而惊，谢汉使，武等果在。

背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 箭矢破空。
第 2 行：4. 命中靶心墨点；5. 风雪飞白；6. 浪头（过场笔画所绘）。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。
artPrompts.negative: 文字, 书法, 题字, 印章, 边框, 网格线, 底纹, 纸纹, 背景色, 白底, 阴影, 倒影, 水印, 写实照片, 3D 渲染, 厚涂, 现代器物, 现代服饰, 多余肢体, 五官崩坏, 全彩, 多色, 粉彩, 马卡龙色, Q 版, 萌系, 大头娃娃, 精细繁复纹理, 大量渐变的 CG 质感, 金色高光, 蒸汽朋克机械, 细密界画线条, 细密皴纹, 复杂五官, 日本刀（武士刀）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝天汉元年至昭帝始元六年（前 100—前 81 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。
setting.en: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 100 BCE–81 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

characters.name: 苏武
characters.zh: 苏武（汉·中郎将）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；持节出使，被扣十九年不屈
characters.en: Su Wu (苏武) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 李陵
characters.zh: 李陵（汉→匈奴·骑都尉）：草原游牧装束：皮袍、毡帽、皮靴，佩弓刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；兵败降匈奴，奉单于命劝降苏武
characters.en: Li Ling (李陵) — general, 汉→匈奴; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 卫律
characters.zh: 卫律（匈奴·丁灵王）：草原游牧装束：皮袍、毡帽、皮靴，佩弓刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；汉人降匈奴者，逼降苏武
characters.en: Wei Lü (卫律) — minister, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 常惠
characters.zh: 常惠（汉·副使属官）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；教汉使以雁书之辞，求还苏武
characters.en: Chang Hui (常惠) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 张胜
characters.zh: 张胜（汉·副中郎将）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与虞常谋劫阏氏，事泄
characters.en: Zhang Sheng (张胜) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 且鞮侯单于
characters.zh: 且鞮侯单于（匈奴·匈奴单于）：草原游牧装束：皮袍、毡帽、皮靴，佩弓刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；扣留苏武，徙之北海
characters.en: Qie Dihou Chanyu (且鞮侯单于) — ruler, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：江海、浪头；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：北海之上，冰原无人｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片；大笔湿墨铺出海面，浪头留白；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：草原风｜屏幕文字：片名「北海牧羊」竖排书法与朱印「持节十九年」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sea, breaking waves; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: An empty frozen plain by the Northern Sea | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes; broad wet-ink sea with white-paper wave crests; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「北海牧羊」 with vermilion seal 「持节十九年」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。」

shots.vo: 卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–17 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：卫律、苏武、大刀｜动作：卫律举剑，苏武引佩刀自刺｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：刀鸣｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–17 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wei Lü, Su Wu, broadsword | Action: Wei Lü raises a sword; Su Wu stabs himself with his own knife | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。」

shots.vo: 单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–27 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：苏武；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：大窖之中，啮雪与旃毛并咽之｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：低风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：引文「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–27 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Su Wu; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: In a cellar he eats snow with felt | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。」

shots.vo: 匈奴以为神，把他迁到北海无人之处，让他牧公羊，说：公羊生了小羊，就放你回去。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（27–37 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：草；主体：苏武；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：杖汉节牧羊，节旄尽落｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「匈奴以为神，把他迁到北海无人之处，让他牧公羊，说：公羊生了小羊，就放你回去。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (27–37 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Su Wu; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: He herds sheep holding the Han tally until its tassels fall away | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「匈奴以为神，把他迁到北海无人之处，让他牧公羊，说：公羊生了小羊，就放你回去。」

shots.vo: 苏武杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：李陵、苏武｜动作：李陵置酒，泣下沾衿｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风、碰杯｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「苏武杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Li Ling, Su Wu | Action: Li Ling pours wine and weeps | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: wind gust, clinking cups | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「苏武杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落——」

shots.vo: 昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（43–56 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：李陵、苏武｜动作：正史结局：昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (43–56 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Li Ling, Su Wu | Action: Canonical outcome: When Han asks for him the Xiongnu claim he is dead; told of a letter tied to a goose, the chanyu relents and Su Wu returns home. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。」

shots.vo: 武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白
shots.zh: 镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」，下署《汉书·苏武传》；右下角朱印「持节十九年」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」
shots.en: Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」 signed 《汉书·苏武传》; vermilion seal 「持节十九年」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」

sound.zh: 背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、低风；音效：刀鸣、阵风、碰杯；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: steppe wind, low wind; SFX: ringing blade, wind gust, clinking cups; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。
卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。
单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。
匈奴以为神，把他迁到北海无人之处，让他牧公羊，说：公羊生了小羊，就放你回去。
苏武杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落——
昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。
武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】楚汉 · 西汉 · 北海牧羊（苏武）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 62 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝天汉元年至昭帝始元六年（前 100—前 81 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 苏武（汉·中郎将）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；持节出使，被扣十九年不屈
- 李陵（汉→匈奴·骑都尉）：草原游牧装束：皮袍、毡帽、皮靴，佩弓刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；兵败降匈奴，奉单于命劝降苏武
- 卫律（匈奴·丁灵王）：草原游牧装束：皮袍、毡帽、皮靴，佩弓刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；汉人降匈奴者，逼降苏武
- 常惠（汉·副使属官）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；教汉使以雁书之辞，求还苏武
- 张胜（汉·副中郎将）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与虞常谋劫阏氏，事泄
- 且鞮侯单于（匈奴·匈奴单于）：草原游牧装束：皮袍、毡帽、皮靴，佩弓刀；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；扣留苏武，徙之北海

分镜：
镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：江海、浪头；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：北海之上，冰原无人｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片；大笔湿墨铺出海面，浪头留白；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：草原风｜屏幕文字：片名「北海牧羊」竖排书法与朱印「持节十九年」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。」
镜头 2（10–17 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：卫律、苏武、大刀｜动作：卫律举剑，苏武引佩刀自刺｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：刀鸣｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。」
镜头 3（17–27 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：苏武；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：大窖之中，啮雪与旃毛并咽之｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：低风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：引文「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。」
镜头 4（27–37 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：草；主体：苏武；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：杖汉节牧羊，节旄尽落｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「匈奴以为神，把他迁到北海无人之处，让他牧公羊，说：公羊生了小羊，就放你回去。」
镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：李陵、苏武｜动作：李陵置酒，泣下沾衿｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：阵风、碰杯｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「苏武杖汉节牧羊，卧起操持，节旄尽落——」
镜头 6（43–56 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：李陵、苏武｜动作：正史结局：昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「昭帝即位数年，匈奴与汉和亲。汉求苏武，匈奴诡言武已死。常惠夜见汉使，教以雁书之辞。单于惊谢，苏武得归，拜为典属国。」
镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」，下署《汉书·苏武传》；右下角朱印「持节十九年」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：草原风、低风；音效：刀鸣、阵风、碰杯；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「北海牧羊」、副题「苏武」、朱印「持节十九年」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」——《汉书·苏武传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Herding Sheep by the Northern Sea: Su Wu (「北海牧羊」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 62 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 100 BCE–81 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Su Wu (苏武) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Ling (李陵) — general, 汉→匈奴; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wei Lü (卫律) — minister, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Chang Hui (常惠) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang Sheng (张胜) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qie Dihou Chanyu (且鞮侯单于) — ruler, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: sea, breaking waves; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: An empty frozen plain by the Northern Sea | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes; broad wet-ink sea with white-paper wave crests; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: steppe wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「北海牧羊」 with vermilion seal 「持节十九年」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天汉元年，苏武以中郎将持节送匈奴使者归国。副使张胜卷入匈奴内部的谋乱，事泄。」
Shot 2 (10–17 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wei Lü, Su Wu, broadsword | Action: Wei Lü raises a sword; Su Wu stabs himself with his own knife | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卫律奉单于之命逼降，苏武引佩刀自刺，几死，被救活。」
Shot 3 (17–27 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Su Wu; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: In a cellar he eats snow with felt | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「武留匈奴凡十九岁，始以强壮出，及还，须发尽白」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「单于把他幽禁在大窖中，不给饮食。天降雪，苏武卧啮雪，与旃毛并咽之，数日不死。」

strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.title: 发愤著书
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.subtitle: 司马迁
strings.vo.01: 司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。
strings.vo.02: 前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。
strings.vo.03: 武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。
strings.vo.04: 受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。
strings.vo.05: 多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.quote: 人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.fork.prompt: 发愤著书——依《汉书》直书，还是听异说「三国志·王肃传」？
strings.anchor.lilingjiang: 李陵兵败降匈奴，司马迁为之辩护
strings.anchor.renan: 司马迁作《报任安书》，书成
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.canon.intro: 一个史官因为替败将说了几句话，受了最屈辱的刑罚。他没有去死，因为书还没写完。
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.end.canon: 司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。他写成了一百三十篇、五十二万六千五百字的《太史公书》，就是后来的《史记》。
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.pick.legend: 异说 · 三国志·王肃传
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《三国志·魏书·王肃传》所载王肃对魏明帝之语：武帝听说司马迁著史，取《孝景本纪》和自己的本纪来看，大怒，削去投掉。此说出于三百年后的魏人，真伪难考；今本《史记》中的《孝景本纪》《孝武本纪》确有残缺。
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.legend.intro: 三百多年后，魏明帝问王肃：司马迁受刑，心怀隐恨，著书非贬孝武，令人切齿。
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.end.legend: 王肃说，《孝景本纪》《孝武本纪》两篇至今有录无书。今本《孝武本纪》多取《封禅书》补成，是后人所补。
strings.scene.xihan.simaqian.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若司马迁赎刑（未开放）

第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触。
第 2 行：3. 水流笔迹；4. 墨滴下坠。
排版参考尺寸：1024×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。
artPrompts.negative: 文字, 书法, 题字, 印章, 边框, 网格线, 底纹, 纸纹, 背景色, 白底, 阴影, 倒影, 水印, 写实照片, 3D 渲染, 厚涂, 现代器物, 现代服饰, 多余肢体, 五官崩坏, 全彩, 多色, 粉彩, 马卡龙色, Q 版, 萌系, 大头娃娃, 精细繁复纹理, 大量渐变的 CG 质感, 金色高光, 蒸汽朋克机械, 细密界画线条, 细密皴纹, 复杂五官, 日本刀（武士刀）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝天汉二年（前 99 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。
setting.en: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 99 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

characters.name: 司马迁
characters.zh: 司马迁（汉·太史令）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；为李陵辩护受腐刑，发愤著《史记》
characters.en: Sima Qian (司马迁) — scholar, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 汉武帝
characters.zh: 汉武帝（汉·刘彻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；以为诬罔，下迁腐刑
characters.en: Han Wudi (汉武帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 司马谈
characters.zh: 司马谈（汉·太史令，司马迁之父）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；临终执子手泣，嘱其论著
characters.en: Sima Tan (司马谈) — scholar, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 任安
characters.zh: 任安（汉·益州刺史、北军使者护军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；致书司马迁，后迁作书报之
characters.en: Ren An (任安) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马谈、司马迁｜动作：洛阳，病榻上的老太史令握着儿子的手，泪流满面｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：咳嗽｜屏幕文字：片名「发愤著书」竖排书法与朱印「太史公」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Tan, Sima Qian | Action: In Luoyang the dying Grand Historian grips his son's hand, tears streaming down his face | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: cough | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「发愤著书」 with vermilion seal 「太史公」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。」

shots.vo: 前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–32 秒，18 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马迁、汉武帝、众人｜动作：未央宫前殿，满朝文武附和天子，只有一个人为李陵说话｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–32 s, 18 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Qian, Han Wudi, crowd | Action: In the front hall of Weiyang Palace all the officials echo the emperor; only one man speaks up for Li Ling | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。」

shots.vo: 武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（32–44 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马迁｜动作：蚕室，昏暗无光，他蜷在墙角｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：滴水｜屏幕文字：引文「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (32–44 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Qian | Action: In the dark "silkworm chamber" he huddles in a corner | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: dripping water | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。」

shots.vo: 受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（44–57 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：书写；主体：司马迁、竹｜动作：竹简一卷卷堆起，从黄帝写到当朝｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；竹叶撇笔，风中摇动；竹简断裂、墨迹飞溅｜声音：环境：琴室；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (44–57 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 书写; subject: Sima Qian, bamboo | Action: Bamboo scrolls pile up roll after roll, from the Yellow Emperor down to the present reign | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; flicked bamboo leaves swaying; bamboo slips snapping with ink spatter | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。」

shots.vo: 多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（57–64 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：书写；主体：司马迁；飞白题字「太史公」｜动作：一封长信写到最后：藏之名山，传之其人｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (57–64 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 书写; subject: Sima Qian; dry-brush calligraphy 「太史公」 | Action: A long letter ends: store it in the famous mountains and pass it to the right people | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——」

shots.vo: 司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（64–76 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：司马迁｜动作：正史结局：司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (64–76 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Sima Qian | Action: Canonical outcome: Sima Qian completes his 130 chapters, 526,500 characters, the book later known as the Shiji, explaining he endured disgrace so his writing would not be lost to later ages. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。」

shots.vo: 人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（76–82 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」，下署《汉书·司马迁传》；右下角朱印「太史公」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (76–82 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」 signed 《汉书·司马迁传》; vermilion seal 「太史公」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、宫殿回响、琴室、战后余风；音效：咳嗽、低语、滴水、竹简翻动、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, palace hall reverb, guqin room tone, lingering wind after battle; SFX: cough, murmuring, dripping water, bamboo slips rustling, brush dropped; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「发愤著书」、副题「司马迁」、朱印「太史公」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」——《汉书·司马迁传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「发愤著书」, subtitle 「司马迁」 and vermilion seal 「太史公」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」 — 《汉书·司马迁传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly
