narration: 司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。
前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。
武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。
受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。
多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——
司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。
人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】楚汉 · 西汉 · 发愤著书（司马迁）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 82 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝天汉二年（前 99 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 司马迁（汉·太史令）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；为李陵辩护受腐刑，发愤著《史记》
- 汉武帝（汉·刘彻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；以为诬罔，下迁腐刑
- 司马谈（汉·太史令，司马迁之父）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；临终执子手泣，嘱其论著
- 任安（汉·益州刺史、北军使者护军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；致书司马迁，后迁作书报之

分镜：
镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马谈、司马迁｜动作：洛阳，病榻上的老太史令握着儿子的手，泪流满面｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：咳嗽｜屏幕文字：片名「发愤著书」竖排书法与朱印「太史公」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。」
镜头 2（14–32 秒，18 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马迁、汉武帝、众人｜动作：未央宫前殿，满朝文武附和天子，只有一个人为李陵说话｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。」
镜头 3（32–44 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：司马迁｜动作：蚕室，昏暗无光，他蜷在墙角｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：滴水｜屏幕文字：引文「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。」
镜头 4（44–57 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：书写；主体：司马迁、竹｜动作：竹简一卷卷堆起，从黄帝写到当朝｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；竹叶撇笔，风中摇动；竹简断裂、墨迹飞溅｜声音：环境：琴室；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。」
镜头 5（57–64 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：书写；主体：司马迁；飞白题字「太史公」｜动作：一封长信写到最后：藏之名山，传之其人｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：笔落｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——」
镜头 6（64–76 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：司马迁｜动作：正史结局：司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「司马迁在《报任安书》里说，他之所以隐忍苟活，是因为“恨私心有所不尽，鄙陋没世，而文采不表于后也”。」
镜头 7（76–82 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」，下署《汉书·司马迁传》；右下角朱印「太史公」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、宫殿回响、琴室、战后余风；音效：咳嗽、低语、滴水、竹简翻动、笔落；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「发愤著书」、副题「司马迁」、朱印「太史公」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」——《汉书·司马迁传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Writing in Wrath: Sima Qian (「发愤著书」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 82 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 99 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Sima Qian (司马迁) — scholar, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Han Wudi (汉武帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sima Tan (司马谈) — scholar, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ren An (任安) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Tan, Sima Qian | Action: In Luoyang the dying Grand Historian grips his son's hand, tears streaming down his face | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: cough | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「发愤著书」 with vermilion seal 「太史公」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司马迁的父亲司马谈是汉朝的太史令，临终前握着他的手哭着说：我死以后，你必定做太史；做了太史，不要忘了我想要论著的东西。」
Shot 2 (14–32 s, 18 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Qian, Han Wudi, crowd | Action: In the front hall of Weiyang Palace all the officials echo the emperor; only one man speaks up for Li Ling | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 99 年，将军李陵率五千步兵深入匈奴，力战兵败投降。武帝大怒，群臣都说李陵有罪。武帝问司马迁，他说李陵平日为人有国士之风，这次虽败，其功也足以暴露于天下。」
Shot 3 (32–44 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Qian | Action: In the dark "silkworm chamber" he huddles in a corner | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: dripping water | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武帝认为他是在诬蔑贰师将军，替李陵游说，把他下狱，判了腐刑。他家贫，拿不出钱赎罪，亲友也无人相救。」
Shot 4 (44–57 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 书写; subject: Sima Qian, bamboo | Action: Bamboo scrolls pile up roll after roll, from the Yellow Emperor down to the present reign | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; flicked bamboo leaves swaying; bamboo slips snapping with ink spatter | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「受刑之后，他想到西伯拘而演《周易》，孔子厄而作《春秋》，屈原放逐乃赋《离骚》。他忍辱活了下来，继续写那部书。」
Shot 5 (57–64 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 书写; subject: Sima Qian; dry-brush calligraphy 「太史公」 | Action: A long letter ends: store it in the famous mountains and pass it to the right people | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: brush dropped | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「多年后，老友任安来信，他写了一封长长的回信——」

strings.scene.xihan.wugu.title: 巫蛊之祸
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.subtitle: 戾太子
strings.vo.01: 武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。
strings.vo.02: 江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。
strings.vo.03: 少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。
strings.vo.04: 丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。
strings.vo.05: 他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.fork.prompt: 巫蛊之祸——依《汉书》直书，还是听演义《前汉演义》？
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.pick.canon: 正史 · 《汉书·武五子传》所载
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.canon.intro: 太子宫里，地面被掘开一处又一处。江充的人捧出一个桐木人，说是从这里挖到的。
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.end.canon: 吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.legend.disclaimer: 以下按蔡东藩《前汉演义》第七十六回改编，主干同《汉书》，对话与细节为小说增饰。
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.legend.intro: 演义写武帝在甘泉梦见数千木人持杖击己，醒来便疑巫蛊，这个梦在《汉书·江充传》里也有记载。
strings.scene.xihan.wugu.end.legend: 上书递了上去，太子已死。演义的终点与正史相同。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝征和二年（前 91 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。
setting.en: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 91 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

shots.vo: 武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山、云；中景：殿柱、屋檐｜动作：甘泉宫外，夏日炎热｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；云气以淡墨晕染流动｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「巫蛊之祸」竖排书法与朱印「思子之台」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: A hot summer outside Ganquan Palace | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; clouds as moving pale wash | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「巫蛊之祸」 with vermilion seal 「思子之台」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。」

shots.vo: 江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、蛊；主体：江充｜动作：江充掘地，得桐木人｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：夯土闷响｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 蛊; subject: Jiang Chong | Action: Jiang Chong digs up a wooden doll | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: thud of earth | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。」

shots.vo: 少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–26 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：石德、刘据｜动作：石德说太子：秦扶苏之事可鉴｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「子弄父兵，罪当笞」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–26 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Shi De, Liu Ju | Action: Shi De warns the prince of the fate of Fusu | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。」

shots.vo: 丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（26–35 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、烟；主体：军阵、长兵如林｜动作：长安城中合战五日，死者数万｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (26–35 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, smoke; subject: army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Five days of fighting in Chang'an; tens of thousands die | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。」

shots.vo: 他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（35–41 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：关门；主体：刘据；飞白题字「闭户」｜动作：湖县泉鸠里，门已闭｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：钟鸣｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (35–41 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Liu Ju; dry-brush calligraphy 「闭户」 | Action: At Quanjiu in Hu county, the door is shut | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: tolling bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——」

shots.vo: 吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（41–54 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：刘据｜动作：正史结局：吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (41–54 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Liu Ju | Action: Canonical outcome: The prince hangs himself and Empress Wei dies; later Emperor Wu realises the injustice, wipes out Jiang Chong's clan and builds a terrace of longing. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。」

shots.vo: 子弄父兵，罪当笞
shots.zh: 镜头 7（54–60 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「子弄父兵，罪当笞」，下署《汉书·车千秋传》；右下角朱印「思子之台」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「子弄父兵，罪当笞」
shots.en: Shot 7 (54–60 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」 signed 《汉书·车千秋传》; vermilion seal 「思子之台」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、寂静室内、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、战后余风；音效：夯土闷响、竹简翻动、兵刃相击、钟鸣；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: thud of earth, bamboo slips rustling, clashing weapons, tolling bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「巫蛊之祸」、副题「戾太子」、朱印「思子之台」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「子弄父兵，罪当笞」——《汉书·车千秋传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「巫蛊之祸」, subtitle 「戾太子」 and vermilion seal 「思子之台」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」 — 《汉书·车千秋传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。
江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。
少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。
丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。
他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——
吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】楚汉 · 西汉 · 巫蛊之祸（戾太子）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 60 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉武帝征和二年（前 91 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 刘据（汉·戾太子）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；被江充陷以巫蛊，起兵诛充，兵败自经
- 江充（汉·使者）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与太子有隙，借巫蛊陷害太子
- 石德（汉·太子少傅）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；劝太子矫节收捕江充
- 汉武帝（汉·刘彻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；老年；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；晚年多疑，后悔悟，作思子宫
- 卫皇后（汉·卫子夫）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；太子之母，事败自杀
- 刘屈氂（汉·丞相）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；奉诏发兵与太子战于长安
- 车千秋（汉·高寝郎）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟

分镜：
镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山、云；中景：殿柱、屋檐｜动作：甘泉宫外，夏日炎热｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；云气以淡墨晕染流动｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「巫蛊之祸」竖排书法与朱印「思子之台」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。」
镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、蛊；主体：江充｜动作：江充掘地，得桐木人｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：夯土闷响｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。」
镜头 3（17–26 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：石德、刘据｜动作：石德说太子：秦扶苏之事可鉴｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「子弄父兵，罪当笞」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。」
镜头 4（26–35 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、烟；主体：军阵、长兵如林｜动作：长安城中合战五日，死者数万｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。」
镜头 5（35–41 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：关门；主体：刘据；飞白题字「闭户」｜动作：湖县泉鸠里，门已闭｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：钟鸣｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——」
镜头 6（41–54 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：刘据｜动作：正史结局：吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。」
镜头 7（54–60 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「子弄父兵，罪当笞」，下署《汉书·车千秋传》；右下角朱印「思子之台」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「子弄父兵，罪当笞」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、寂静室内、宫殿回响、远处厮杀声、战后余风；音效：夯土闷响、竹简翻动、兵刃相击、钟鸣；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「巫蛊之祸」、副题「戾太子」、朱印「思子之台」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「子弄父兵，罪当笞」——《汉书·车千秋传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · The Witchcraft Affair: Crown Prince Li (「巫蛊之祸」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 60 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 91 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Liu Ju (刘据) — royal / consort, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Jiang Chong (江充) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shi De (石德) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Han Wudi (汉武帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; elderly; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Empress Wei (卫皇后) — royal / consort, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Qumao (刘屈氂) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Che Qianqiu (车千秋) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: A hot summer outside Ganquan Palace | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; clouds as moving pale wash | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「巫蛊之祸」 with vermilion seal 「思子之台」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「武帝晚年多病，疑左右有巫蛊诅咒。江充与太子有隙，受命治巫蛊。」
Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 蛊; subject: Jiang Chong | Action: Jiang Chong digs up a wooden doll | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: thud of earth | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「江充入太子宫掘蛊，说得了桐木人。武帝在甘泉宫养病，太子的使者见不到他。」
Shot 3 (17–26 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Shi De, Liu Ju | Action: Shi De warns the prince of the fate of Fusu | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「少傅石德说：不能自明，可收捕江充等，穷治其奸诈。太子遂矫节斩江充。」
Shot 4 (26–35 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, smoke; subject: army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Five days of fighting in Chang'an; tens of thousands die | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「丞相刘屈氂奉诏发兵，与太子合战长安城中五日，死者数万人。太子兵败出亡。」
Shot 5 (35–41 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Liu Ju; dry-brush calligraphy 「闭户」 | Action: At Quanjiu in Hu county, the door is shut | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: tolling bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他逃到湖县，藏在泉鸠里一户贫家——」
Shot 6 (41–54 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Liu Ju | Action: Canonical outcome: The prince hangs himself and Empress Wei dies; later Emperor Wu realises the injustice, wipes out Jiang Chong's clan and builds a terrace of longing. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「吏围捕甚急，太子自经。卫皇后亦自杀。久之，车千秋上书讼太子冤，武帝感悟，族灭江充家，作思子宫，为归来望思之台于湖。」
Shot 7 (54–60 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」 signed 《汉书·车千秋传》; vermilion seal 「思子之台」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, quiet room tone, palace hall reverb, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: thud of earth, bamboo slips rustling, clashing weapons, tolling bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「巫蛊之祸」, subtitle 「戾太子」 and vermilion seal 「思子之台」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「子弄父兵，罪当笞」 — 《汉书·车千秋传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.title: 二十七日
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.subtitle: 霍光废昌邑王
strings.vo.01: 前 74 年，汉昭帝去世，没有儿子。大将军霍光迎立武帝之孙、昌邑王刘贺即位。
strings.vo.02: 刘贺即位后，行为荒淫。霍光忧懑，与车骑将军张安世等商议，召集群臣到未央宫。大司农田延年按剑上前说：群臣有后应者，臣请剑斩之。
strings.vo.03: 霍光带群臣去见皇太后，太后穿着珠襦盛服坐在武帐中，几百名侍卫持兵器守卫。群臣把刘贺召来，伏在殿前听诏。尚书令读群臣的联名奏章，列举刘贺的种种过失。
strings.vo.04: 奏章说：陛下受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡一千一百二十七事。太后说：停！为人臣子当悖乱如是邪！刘贺离席伏地。
strings.vo.05: 霍光解下他的玺绶，扶他下殿——
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.quote: 受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.fork.prompt: 二十七日——依《汉书》直书，还是听考古《海昏侯墓》？
strings.anchor.yingli: 昭帝崩，无嗣，迎昌邑王刘贺即位
strings.anchor.feili: 皇太后诏废刘贺，归昌邑
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.canon.intro: 刘贺做了二十七天皇帝。罢免他的奏章说，他在这二十七天里做了一千一百二十七件错事。
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.end.canon: 刘贺被送回昌邑，昌邑群臣因“不辅导”被诛杀二百余人。他们临刑时在市中呼号：当断不断，反受其乱。霍光改立武帝曾孙刘病已，就是汉宣帝。刘贺后来被封为海昏侯，死在豫章。
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.legend.disclaimer: 以下取江西南昌海昏侯墓的考古发现：墓中出土了“刘贺”玉印、孔子像漆屏风、大量竹简与金饼。墓中的书籍与礼器显示，这位被废的皇帝也读儒书，与奏章中的形象不尽相同。考古发现不能直接证明奏章是否夸大。
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.legend.intro: 两千年后，南昌郊外的一座大墓被打开。墓主的印章上刻着两个字：刘贺。
strings.scene.xihan.huoguang.end.legend: 墓中的竹简里有《论语》《易经》《礼记》，衣镜上画着孔子像。刘贺是怎样一个人，奏章与墓葬讲了两个不同的故事。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 前 74 年，汉昭帝去世，没有儿子。大将军霍光迎立武帝之孙、昌邑王刘贺即位。
刘贺即位后，行为荒淫。霍光忧懑，与车骑将军张安世等商议，召集群臣到未央宫。大司农田延年按剑上前说：群臣有后应者，臣请剑斩之。
霍光带群臣去见皇太后，太后穿着珠襦盛服坐在武帐中，几百名侍卫持兵器守卫。群臣把刘贺召来，伏在殿前听诏。尚书令读群臣的联名奏章，列举刘贺的种种过失。
奏章说：陛下受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡一千一百二十七事。太后说：停！为人臣子当悖乱如是邪！刘贺离席伏地。
霍光解下他的玺绶，扶他下殿——
刘贺被送回昌邑，昌邑群臣因“不辅导”被诛杀二百余人。他们临刑时在市中呼号：当断不断，反受其乱。霍光改立武帝曾孙刘病已，就是汉宣帝。
受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉昭帝元平元年（前 74 年六月）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 霍光（汉·大司马大将军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与群臣奏废昌邑王，迎立宣帝
- 刘贺（汉·昌邑王，即位二十七日被废）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；受玺以来二十七日，“凡千一百二十七事”
- 上官太后（汉·昭帝皇后，霍光外孙女）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；珠襦盛服坐武帐中，诏废刘贺
- 田延年（汉·大司农）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；按剑廷中，“群臣后应者，臣请剑斩之”
- 张安世（汉·车骑将军）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠，汉式札甲，环首刀；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与霍光定谋

分镜：
镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：田延年、众人、长剑｜动作：未央宫承明殿，群臣列坐，一个大臣按剑站在殿中｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：刀鸣｜屏幕文字：片名「二十七日」竖排书法与朱印「二十七日」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 74 年，汉昭帝去世，没有儿子。大将军霍光迎立武帝之孙、昌邑王刘贺即位。」
镜头 2（9–23 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：上官太后、长枪｜动作：太后穿着珠襦坐在武帐里，侍卫持戟夹立｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：甲片作响｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘贺即位后，行为荒淫。霍光忧懑，与车骑将军张安世等商议，召集群臣到未央宫。大司农田延年按剑上前说：群臣有后应者，臣请剑斩之。」
镜头 3（23–40 秒，17 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：霍光｜动作：尚书令跪读奏章，一条一条，读了很久｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「霍光带群臣去见皇太后，太后穿着珠襦盛服坐在武帐中，几百名侍卫持兵器守卫。群臣把刘贺召来，伏在殿前听诏。尚书令读群臣的联名奏章，列举刘贺的种种过失。」
镜头 4（40–54 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：刘贺、霍光｜动作：年轻的天子伏在地上，玺绶被解下｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：玉磬｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「奏章说：陛下受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡一千一百二十七事。太后说：停！为人臣子当悖乱如是邪！刘贺离席伏地。」
镜头 5（54–60 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：关门；主体：刘贺、众人；飞白题字「二十七日」｜动作：宫门关上，昌邑的旧臣二百余人被押往东市｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：城门闭合｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「霍光解下他的玺绶，扶他下殿——」
镜头 6（60–75 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：刘贺｜动作：正史结局：刘贺被送回昌邑，昌邑群臣因“不辅导”被诛杀二百余人。他们临刑时在市中呼号：当断不断，反受其乱。霍光改立武帝曾孙刘病已，就是汉宣帝。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘贺被送回昌邑，昌邑群臣因“不辅导”被诛杀二百余人。他们临刑时在市中呼号：当断不断，反受其乱。霍光改立武帝曾孙刘病已，就是汉宣帝。」

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：宫殿回响、寂静室内、众人呐喊；音效：刀鸣、甲片作响、竹简翻动、玉磬、城门闭合；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「二十七日」、副题「霍光废昌邑王」、朱印「二十七日」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。」——《汉书·霍光传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Twenty-Seven Days: Huo Guang Deposes the Prince of Changyi (「二十七日」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 81 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 74 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Huo Guang (霍光) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu He (刘贺) — royal / consort, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Empress Dowager Shangguan (上官太后) — royal / consort, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Tian Yannian (田延年) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang Anshi (张安世) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Tian Yannian, crowd, sword | Action: In the Chengming hall of Weiyang Palace the officials sit in rows while one minister stands with his hand on his sword | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「二十七日」 with vermilion seal 「二十七日」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 74 年，汉昭帝去世，没有儿子。大将军霍光迎立武帝之孙、昌邑王刘贺即位。」
Shot 2 (9–23 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Empress Dowager Shangguan, spear | Action: The empress dowager sits in a pearl-sewn robe inside a military tent, guards with halberds on either side | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rattling armour | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘贺即位后，行为荒淫。霍光忧懑，与车骑将军张安世等商议，召集群臣到未央宫。大司农田延年按剑上前说：群臣有后应者，臣请剑斩之。」
Shot 3 (23–40 s, 17 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Huo Guang | Action: The Master of Writing kneels and reads the memorial, item after item, for a long time | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「霍光带群臣去见皇太后，太后穿着珠襦盛服坐在武帐中，几百名侍卫持兵器守卫。群臣把刘贺召来，伏在殿前听诏。尚书令读群臣的联名奏章，列举刘贺的种种过失。」
Shot 4 (40–54 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Liu He, Huo Guang | Action: The young emperor lies prostrate on the floor as his seals and ribbons are removed | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: jade chime | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「奏章说：陛下受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡一千一百二十七事。太后说：停！为人臣子当悖乱如是邪！刘贺离席伏地。」
Shot 5 (54–60 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Liu He, crowd; dry-brush calligraphy 「二十七日」 | Action: The palace gate shuts and more than two hundred of his old Changyi officials are led to the execution ground | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: gate slamming shut | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「霍光解下他的玺绶，扶他下殿——」
Shot 6 (60–75 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Liu He | Action: Canonical outcome: Liu He is sent home and his officials executed; Huo Guang enthrones Liu Bingyi as Emperor Xuan, and Liu He later dies as Marquis of Haihun in Yuzhang. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘贺被送回昌邑，昌邑群臣因“不辅导”被诛杀二百余人。他们临刑时在市中呼号：当断不断，反受其乱。霍光改立武帝曾孙刘病已，就是汉宣帝。」
Shot 7 (75–81 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。」 signed 《汉书·霍光传》; vermilion seal 「二十七日」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。」

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, quiet room tone, roaring crowd; SFX: ringing blade, rattling armour, bamboo slips rustling, jade chime, gate slamming shut; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「二十七日」, subtitle 「霍光废昌邑王」 and vermilion seal 「二十七日」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「受玺以来二十七日，使者旁午，持节诏诸官署征发，凡千一百二十七事。」 — 《汉书·霍光传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

shots.note: 长安尚冠里，一对年轻夫妻住在陋巷，墙上挂着一把旧剑
未央宫，公卿们建议立大将军的小女儿为后
天子下了一道奇怪的诏书：寻找我贫贱时的一把旧剑
皇后分娩之后，女医端来一碗药丸
皇后问：我头岑岑也，药中得无有毒

strings.scene.xihan.gujian.title: 故剑情深
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.subtitle: 许平君
strings.vo.01: 汉宣帝刘病已是武帝的曾孙，幼年因巫蛊之祸流落民间。他娶了暴室啬夫许广汉的女儿许平君，生下儿子刘奭。
strings.vo.02: 霍光迎立他即位后，公卿们议立皇后，都暗中属意大将军霍光的小女儿。
strings.vo.03: 宣帝却下了一道诏书：寻找我微贱时用过的一把旧剑。大臣们明白了皇帝的心意，于是建议立许婕妤为皇后。
strings.vo.04: 三年后，许皇后临产。霍光的妻子霍显想让自己的女儿做皇后，买通女医淳于衍，在药丸里掺入附子。
strings.vo.05: 皇后服了药，说——
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.quote: 上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.fork.prompt: 故剑情深——依《汉书》直书，还是听民间「南园遗爱」？
strings.anchor.qiugujian: 宣帝诏求微时故剑，群臣议立许婕妤为后
strings.anchor.xuhoubeng: 许皇后产后为霍显使女医淳于衍毒死
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.canon.intro: 一道寻找旧剑的诏书，让一个出身卑微的女子成了皇后。三年后，她死在了产床上。
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.end.canon: 许皇后服药后说头痛，问药中是否有毒，不久就去世了。霍显的女儿霍成君被立为皇后。霍光死后，事情泄露，霍氏谋反被族灭，霍皇后被废。许平君的儿子刘奭后来即位，就是汉元帝。
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.legend.disclaimer: 以下取后世对许后葬地“南园”的追述：许后葬于杜南，号为少陵；宣帝死后葬杜陵，与之相望。“故剑情深”“南园遗爱”成了成语与诗题。陵名见于《汉书》，夫妻相望之说为后人感叹之辞。
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.legend.intro: 许皇后葬在长安城南，陵名少陵。后人说，宣帝的杜陵与她遥遥相望。
strings.scene.xihan.gujian.end.legend: 八百年后，一个住在少陵附近的诗人自号“少陵野老”，他就是杜甫。许平君的名字随着这个号流传了下来。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉宣帝元平元年至本始三年（前 74—前 71 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。
setting.en: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 74 BCE–71 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

characters.name: 许平君
characters.zh: 许平君（汉·宣帝微时之妻，后为皇后）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；宣帝诏求故剑而立为后；产后被毒死
characters.en: Xu Pingjun (许平君) — royal / consort, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 汉宣帝
characters.zh: 汉宣帝（汉·刘询，即位前名病已）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；诏求微时故剑，立许氏为后
characters.en: Han Xuandi (汉宣帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 淳于衍
characters.zh: 淳于衍（汉·女医）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；受霍显之托，以附子入药
characters.en: Chun Yuyan (淳于衍) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 霍显
characters.zh: 霍显（汉·霍光之妻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲以小女为后，使女医毒死许后

shots.vo: 汉宣帝刘病已是武帝的曾孙，幼年因巫蛊之祸流落民间。他娶了暴室啬夫许广汉的女儿许平君，生下儿子刘奭。

shots.vo: 三年后，许皇后临产。霍光的妻子霍显想让自己的女儿做皇后，买通女医淳于衍，在药丸里掺入附子。

shots.vo: 皇后服了药，说——

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：村落人声、宫殿回响、寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲、低语、竹简翻动、滴水、哭泣；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: village ambience, palace hall reverb, quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk, murmuring, bamboo slips rustling, dripping water, weeping; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「故剑情深」、副题「许平君」、朱印「故剑」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」——《汉书·外戚传上》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「故剑情深」, subtitle 「许平君」 and vermilion seal 「故剑」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」 — 《汉书·外戚传上》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 汉宣帝刘病已是武帝的曾孙，幼年因巫蛊之祸流落民间。他娶了暴室啬夫许广汉的女儿许平君，生下儿子刘奭。
霍光迎立他即位后，公卿们议立皇后，都暗中属意大将军霍光的小女儿。
宣帝却下了一道诏书：寻找我微贱时用过的一把旧剑。大臣们明白了皇帝的心意，于是建议立许婕妤为皇后。
三年后，许皇后临产。霍光的妻子霍显想让自己的女儿做皇后，买通女医淳于衍，在药丸里掺入附子。
皇后服了药，说——
许皇后服药后说头痛，问药中是否有毒，不久就去世了。霍显的女儿霍成君被立为皇后。霍光死后，事情泄露，霍氏谋反被族灭，霍皇后被废。
上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】楚汉 · 西汉 · 故剑情深（许平君）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 71 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：楚汉 · 西汉 · 汉宣帝元平元年至本始三年（前 74—前 71 年）。未央宫、长安城、军营帐幕、丝路驼队。

人物：
- 许平君（汉·宣帝微时之妻，后为皇后）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；宣帝诏求故剑而立为后；产后被毒死
- 汉宣帝（汉·刘询，即位前名病已）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；诏求微时故剑，立许氏为后
- 淳于衍（汉·女医）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；受霍显之托，以附子入药
- 霍显（汉·霍光之妻）：曲裾深衣，进贤冠；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲以小女为后，使女医毒死许后

分镜：
镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：汉宣帝、许平君、长剑｜动作：长安尚冠里，一对年轻夫妻住在陋巷，墙上挂着一把旧剑｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：村落人声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「故剑情深」竖排书法与朱印「故剑」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「汉宣帝刘病已是武帝的曾孙，幼年因巫蛊之祸流落民间。他娶了暴室啬夫许广汉的女儿许平君，生下儿子刘奭。」
镜头 2（12–21 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：汉宣帝、众人｜动作：未央宫，公卿们建议立大将军的小女儿为后｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「霍光迎立他即位后，公卿们议立皇后，都暗中属意大将军霍光的小女儿。」
镜头 3（21–33 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：汉宣帝、长剑｜动作：天子下了一道奇怪的诏书：寻找我贫贱时的一把旧剑｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：引文「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宣帝却下了一道诏书：寻找我微贱时用过的一把旧剑。大臣们明白了皇帝的心意，于是建议立许婕妤为皇后。」
镜头 4（33–44 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：淳于衍、许平君｜动作：皇后分娩之后，女医端来一碗药丸｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：滴水｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「三年后，许皇后临产。霍光的妻子霍显想让自己的女儿做皇后，买通女医淳于衍，在药丸里掺入附子。」
镜头 5（44–50 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：许平君；飞白题字「故剑」｜动作：皇后问：我头岑岑也，药中得无有毒｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：哭泣｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「皇后服了药，说——」
镜头 6（50–65 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：许平君｜动作：正史结局：许皇后服药后说头痛，问药中是否有毒，不久就去世了。霍显的女儿霍成君被立为皇后。霍光死后，事情泄露，霍氏谋反被族灭，霍皇后被废。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「许皇后服药后说头痛，问药中是否有毒，不久就去世了。霍显的女儿霍成君被立为皇后。霍光死后，事情泄露，霍氏谋反被族灭，霍皇后被废。」
镜头 7（65–71 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」，下署《汉书·外戚传上》；右下角朱印「故剑」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：村落人声、宫殿回响、寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲、低语、竹简翻动、滴水、哭泣；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「故剑情深」、副题「许平君」、朱印「故剑」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」——《汉书·外戚传上》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · The Old Sword: Xu Pingjun (「故剑情深」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 71 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 74 BCE–71 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Xu Pingjun (许平君) — royal / consort, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Han Xuandi (汉宣帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Chun Yuyan (淳于衍) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Huo Xian (霍显) — commoner, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Han Xuandi, Xu Pingjun, sword | Action: In Chang'an's Shangguan ward a young couple live in a poor lane, an old sword hanging on the wall | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: village ambience; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「故剑情深」 with vermilion seal 「故剑」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汉宣帝刘病已是武帝的曾孙，幼年因巫蛊之祸流落民间。他娶了暴室啬夫许广汉的女儿许平君，生下儿子刘奭。」
Shot 2 (12–21 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Han Xuandi, crowd | Action: In Weiyang Palace the ministers propose making the regent's youngest daughter empress | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「霍光迎立他即位后，公卿们议立皇后，都暗中属意大将军霍光的小女儿。」
Shot 3 (21–33 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Han Xuandi, sword | Action: The emperor issues a strange edict: find the old sword I used in my humble days | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宣帝却下了一道诏书：寻找我微贱时用过的一把旧剑。大臣们明白了皇帝的心意，于是建议立许婕妤为皇后。」
Shot 4 (33–44 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Chun Yuyan, Xu Pingjun | Action: After the empress gives birth, a woman physician brings her a bowl of pills | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: dripping water | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「三年后，许皇后临产。霍光的妻子霍显想让自己的女儿做皇后，买通女医淳于衍，在药丸里掺入附子。」
Shot 5 (44–50 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Xu Pingjun; dry-brush calligraphy 「故剑」 | Action: The empress asks: my head is spinning — is there poison in this medicine? | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: weeping | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「皇后服了药，说——」
Shot 6 (50–65 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Xu Pingjun | Action: Canonical outcome: Empress Xu dies; after Huo Guang's death the plot comes out, the Huo clan is wiped out, and her son eventually reigns as Emperor Yuan. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「许皇后服药后说头痛，问药中是否有毒，不久就去世了。霍显的女儿霍成君被立为皇后。霍光死后，事情泄露，霍氏谋反被族灭，霍皇后被废。」
Shot 7 (65–71 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」 signed 《汉书·外戚传上》; vermilion seal 「故剑」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: village ambience, palace hall reverb, quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk, murmuring, bamboo slips rustling, dripping water, weeping; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「故剑情深」, subtitle 「许平君」 and vermilion seal 「故剑」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「上乃诏求微时故剑。大臣知指，白立许婕妤为皇后。」 — 《汉书·外戚传上》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.xihan.chentang.title: 明犯强汉者
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.subtitle: 陈汤
strings.vo.01: 匈奴郅支单于杀汉使，西走康居，筑城于都赖水上，侵陵乌孙、大宛。
strings.vo.02: 副校尉陈汤对都护甘延寿说：发屯田吏士，驱从乌孙众兵，直指其城，千载之功可一朝而成。
strings.vo.03: 甘延寿想先奏请朝廷。适逢他病了，陈汤独自矫制，发城郭诸国兵与车师屯田吏士。
strings.vo.04: 甘延寿闻之惊起，欲止之。汤怒，按剑叱之：大众已集会，竖子欲沮众耶？
strings.vo.05: 四万余人，分为六校，西向而行——
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.fork.prompt: 明犯强汉者——依《汉书》直书，还是听演义《前汉演义》？
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.canon.intro: 郅支城外是一道土城，土城外又是两重木城。单于的阏氏夫人数十人都上了城头。
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.end.canon: 汉军斩郅支单于首，上疏请悬其头于槀街蛮夷邸间。朝中为封赏争论良久，元帝终赦矫制之罪，封甘延寿为义成侯，赐陈汤爵关内侯。
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.legend.disclaimer: 以下按蔡东藩《前汉演义》第九十回改编，主干同《汉书》，增写朝中石显与匡衡阻挠封赏的过程，对话为小说增饰。
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.legend.intro: 演义说：石显曾想把姐姐嫁给甘延寿，甘延寿不肯，石显因此记恨，与匡衡一同阻挠封赏。
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.end.legend: 封赏落定，比功劳小得多。演义的终点与正史相同。
strings.scene.xihan.chentang.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若甘延寿坚持奏请（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 匈奴郅支单于杀汉使，西走康居，筑城于都赖水上，侵陵乌孙、大宛。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞｜动作：康居之地，都赖水上的土城｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：大漠风｜屏幕文字：片名「明犯强汉者」竖排书法与朱印「虽远必诛」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「匈奴郅支单于杀汉使，西走康居，筑城于都赖水上，侵陵乌孙、大宛。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall | Action: An earthen fort on the Talas River in Kangju | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; scorched-ink outline of battlements; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: desert wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「明犯强汉者」 with vermilion seal 「虽远必诛」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「匈奴郅支单于杀汉使，西走康居，筑城于都赖水上，侵陵乌孙、大宛。」

shots.vo: 副校尉陈汤对都护甘延寿说：发屯田吏士，驱从乌孙众兵，直指其城，千载之功可一朝而成。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–18 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：陈汤、甘延寿｜动作：陈汤按剑叱甘延寿｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：刀鸣｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「副校尉陈汤对都护甘延寿说：发屯田吏士，驱从乌孙众兵，直指其城，千载之功可一朝而成。」

narration: 匈奴郅支单于杀汉使，西走康居，筑城于都赖水上，侵陵乌孙、大宛。
副校尉陈汤对都护甘延寿说：发屯田吏士，驱从乌孙众兵，直指其城，千载之功可一朝而成。
甘延寿想先奏请朝廷。适逢他病了，陈汤独自矫制，发城郭诸国兵与车师屯田吏士。
甘延寿闻之惊起，欲止之。汤怒，按剑叱之：大众已集会，竖子欲沮众耶？
四万余人，分为六校，西向而行——
汉军斩郅支单于首，上疏请悬其头于槀街蛮夷邸间。朝中为封赏争论良久，元帝终赦矫制之罪，封甘延寿为义成侯，赐陈汤爵关内侯。
明犯强汉者，虽远必诛

镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」，下署《汉书·陈汤传》；右下角朱印「虽远必诛」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」

声音：背景乐：胡笳，边塞悲凉，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：大漠风、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声、火声、众人呐喊；音效：刀鸣、马蹄声、放箭、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「明犯强汉者」、副题「陈汤」、朱印「虽远必诛」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」——《汉书·陈汤传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE) · Whoever Offends Mighty Han: Chen Tang (「明犯强汉者」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 62 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Chu-Han contention and Western Han (206 BCE–8 CE), 36 BCE — Weiyang Palace, Chang'an, army tents, Silk Road camel caravans.

Characters:
- Chen Tang (陈汤) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Gan Yanshou (甘延寿) — general, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps, Han lamellar armour, ring-pommel swords; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhizhi Chanyu (郅支单于) — ruler, Xiongnu; steppe nomad dress: fur-lined robes, felt hats, leather boots, bow and sabre; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Han Yuandi (汉元帝) — ruler, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Kuang Heng (匡衡) — minister, Han; curved-hem shenyi robes, jinxian scholar caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall | Action: An earthen fort on the Talas River in Kangju | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; scorched-ink outline of battlements; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: desert wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「明犯强汉者」 with vermilion seal 「虽远必诛」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「匈奴郅支单于杀汉使，西走康居，筑城于都赖水上，侵陵乌孙、大宛。」
Shot 2 (8–18 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Chen Tang, Gan Yanshou | Action: Chen Tang grips his sword and shouts down Gan Yanshou | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「副校尉陈汤对都护甘延寿说：发屯田吏士，驱从乌孙众兵，直指其城，千载之功可一朝而成。」
Shot 3 (18–28 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: sand; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: Forty thousand men in six divisions | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「甘延寿想先奏请朝廷。适逢他病了，陈汤独自矫制，发城郭诸国兵与车师屯田吏士。」
Shot 4 (28–36 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Zhizhi Chanyu, shield wall, fire (splashed ink) | Action: Fire outside the wooden wall; the chanyu's wives shoot from the ramparts | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「甘延寿闻之惊起，欲止之。汤怒，按剑叱之：大众已集会，竖子欲沮众耶？」
Shot 5 (36–42 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: shield wall; dry-brush calligraphy 「土城」 | Action: The chanyu is beheaded | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「四万余人，分为六校，西向而行——」
Shot 6 (42–56 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Zhizhi's head is sent to Chang'an; after long debate the emperor pardons the forged order and rewards both commanders. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「汉军斩郅支单于首，上疏请悬其头于槀街蛮夷邸间。朝中为封赏争论良久，元帝终赦矫制之罪，封甘延寿为义成侯，赐陈汤爵关内侯。」
Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」 signed 《汉书·陈汤传》; vermilion seal 「虽远必诛」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」

Sound: Music: hujia reed pipe, bleak frontier mood, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: desert wind, camp drums, distant battle, fire, roaring crowd; SFX: ringing blade, hoofbeats, arrow release, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「明犯强汉者」, subtitle 「陈汤」 and vermilion seal 「虽远必诛」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「明犯强汉者，虽远必诛」 — 《汉书·陈汤传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.title: 昭君出塞
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.subtitle: 宁胡阏氏
strings.vo.01: 竟宁元年，匈奴呼韩邪单于来朝，愿婿汉氏以自亲。
strings.vo.02: 王嫱以良家子入掖庭，数年不得见御，积悲怨，自请掖庭令求行。
strings.vo.03: 临辞大会，元帝召五女示单于。昭君丰容靓饰，光明汉宫，顾景徘徊，竦动左右。
strings.vo.04: 元帝见了大惊，想留下她，又难以失信。
strings.vo.05: 车马出了长安，向北——
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.quote: 昭君丰容靓饰，光明汉宫，顾景裴回，竦动左右
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.fork.prompt: 昭君出塞——依《汉书》直书，还是听笔记「画工毛延寿」？
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.pick.canon: 正史 · 《后汉书·南匈奴列传》所载
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.canon.intro: 掖庭里的良家子很多，王嫱入宫已有数年，从未见过天子一面。
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.end.canon: 昭君号宁胡阏氏，生一子。呼韩邪死后，昭君上书求归，成帝敕令从胡俗，遂复为后单于阏氏。此后数十年，汉与匈奴边塞无事。
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《西京杂记》，旧题汉刘歆撰、晋葛洪辑，属笔记小说，史书不载。
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.legend.intro: 《西京杂记》说：元帝令画工图宫人之形，按图召幸。宫人皆贿画工，独王嫱不肯，画工便把她画丑了。及至临行，元帝才见其貌，后悔不及，穷案其事，画工毛延寿等皆弃市。
strings.scene.xihan.zhaojun.end.legend: 画工伏法，昭君已远。笔记的结局汇回正史：出塞和亲。
